sideB.text:
EXTENDED TIME

The current player gains 3 actions.
sideB.footer: Play during any player's "Actions" step. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: Drawn while continuing the Legacy deck at Game End step 2 of the first February game (after 02-07). The next card is the March STOP 03-01, which ends that reading. This face is a Rationed Event, so it enters the reserve. It is not played when it comes off the Legacy deck.
addsToPool: Rationed Event: Extended Time (this card), to the reserve
rules: Play during any player's Actions step. Not an action.
Discard after use, like other Rationed Events. It counts toward the rationing-level pick when the group builds a Player deck.
mechanics.notes: Side A is the Player-card back and has no printed code. The screen art shows a hand holding a timer marked +3.
